subject: CollabBridge integration: proposed account alignment and pipeline triage
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah@collabbridge.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CollabBridge integration: proposed account alignment and pipeline triage

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed, there are a handful of overlapping accounts between CollabBridge and Redwood where we both have active pipeline. To avoid duplicative outreach and to ensure the same customer gets a cohesive message, I put together a first-pass routing map (attached) and a short set of tie-breaker rules I’d like to propose.

Key asks:
- Can you confirm which of the accounts in tab “Overlap_Accounts” CollabBridge considers motion-owned vs. partner-introduced?
- Are there any existing channel agreements or co-sell commitments on your side that would change the default rules?
- If we agree on a simple handoff rule today (suggested below), can we lock it in for the current deals and update our CRM tags?

Proposed short rule (for discussion):
- If CollabBridge has active SOW/PSA or named AM involvement in last 90 days -> CollabBridge owns outreach for renewal/expansion; Redwood gets 'bridge' credit and receives lead routing for technical follow-ups.
- Otherwise, Redwood owns initial commercial engagement and loops CollabBridge for any platform/integration discussions.
- For strategic accounts (>$250k ARR), escalate to joint AM sync and assign a single executive sponsor.

I’ve attached: CollabBridge_Routing_Map_v2.xlsx (mapping, flags, recommended owner) and a draft AM_MutualActionPlan_CB.pdf we could sign off on for the pilot.

If that looks reasonable, can we schedule a 30-minute alignment call next week (Mon/Tue preferred)? I’ll defer to you on the attendee list — happy to include our solutions team if you want technical alignment in the same call.

Thanks —
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Alliances Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Marissa,

Appreciate the clear mapping — this is exactly the operational detail we need. Quick answers:
- I reviewed the Overlap_Accounts tab. CollabBridge claims active ownership on 8 of the 21 accounts (we have PSAs or named AMs). I flagged them in the spreadsheet with a green tag.
- We do have co-sell language in place with one strategic customer (Acme Corp) — I'm looping David Li from Acme on this thread so he sees the plan.
- Your proposed tie-breaker rules look good as a starting point. We may ask for a short 60-day pilot for the 'bridge owner' tag so our CSMs can track conversion lift.

Can we do Monday 3/29 at 10am PT for a 30-minute alignment? If that works, I’ll invite our channel ops lead as well.

Thanks,
Sarah

Marissa / Laura —

Quick internal notes before the call:
- For tie-breakers, add an explicit line for marketing-sourced leads: whoever first converts the MQL to a qualified opportunity gets primary outreach ownership for 120 days (prevents ping-pong).
- Add an SLA for response times when an owner requests a technical handoff (we suggest 48 business hours).
- For ACME (the co-sell customer Sarah mentioned), we should propose a joint exec sponsor and split commission per the 60/40 model in our partner plan. Laura, can you pull the existing commission schedule and any signed co-sell amendments?
- Prepare a short script for AMs to use when they introduce the partner — two sentences to keep messaging consistent.

I’ll bring suggested CRM tags and a draft workflow to the meeting.

— Sergio
Sr. Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com

Thanks, Sarah — great context and thanks for looping David.

We’re aligned on next steps:
1) Pilot: implement 'bridge owner' tag and the tie-breaker rules for 60 days for the accounts marked green in the spreadsheet.
2) CRM updates: Sergio will push the new tags and the two-line AM script (internal). Laura will surface commission schedule for Acme and confirm the split.
3) SLAs: 48 business hours for tech handoffs; 120 days ownership window for MQL converts (Sergio to document).
4) Call: Monday 2027-03-29, 10:00am PT — invite sent (30 min).

David — if you’re available, we'd appreciate a quick 10-minute confirmation on the co-sell split before we finalize the AM plan. If not, we’ll proceed with the 60/40 split as discussed internally and revisit after your input.

Attached is a slightly updated AM_MutualActionPlan_CB.pdf that reflects the 60-day pilot language.

See you both on Monday.

Best,
Marissa
